title: Box 40, one line more
logline: Box 40's lid in March: the register line that was left open after the dash now has a month after it, and a second dash, still open. The pencil. Seven weeks.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard box lid marked 40 with a pencilled register line beneath it now carrying two months and an open dash at its end, the pencil beside it, lamplight.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid marked with a number and a pencilled line beneath it ending in an open dash, a pencil lying beside it in lamplight, no words legible
image.notes: Letter after: BOX 40 · NOV 2026 – MAR 2027 – . Compare ro_2026-11-22.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
